Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT și Servicii de proiectare sisteme IT
Since its foundation in 2007, CCN Holding has become one of Türkiye’s leading and diversified investment groups, operating across Construction, Healthcare, Technology, Education, Tourism and Services.
 CCN Construction Group delivers large-scale EPC and healthcare projects as both a contractor and investor. In 2022, CCN Holding established its Bucharest Branch Office to participate in hospital tenders in Romania and oversee awarded projects. CCN is currently executing the Dimitrie Gerota Emergency Hospital Project for the Ministry of Internal Affairs in Bucharest, SRU Iasi (Spitalul Regional de Urgenta Iasi,) SRU Cluj (Spitalul Regional de Urgenta Cluj), Children Hospital Cluj and continues to expand its international presence through major construction and healthcare projects.
 We are looking for an AI Engineer to join our growing technology team in Romania. You will develop AI-powered solutions, integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise software products and contribute to R&D initiatives across healthcare, facility management and construction.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design and develop AI-powered applications and services.
Integrate generative AI and large language models (LLMs) into existing products.
Develop intelligent assistants, chatbots and AI agent solutions.
Design and implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.
Develop AI-based automation, predictive analytics and decision-support solutions.
Evaluate, optimize and deploy AI models in production environments.
Ensure the reliability, security and scalability of AI applications.
Research emerging AI technologies and develop proof-of-concept solutions.
Contribute to AI-focused R&D projects and collaborate with international teams.
 Required Qualifications 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related field.
At least 5 years of professional experience in software development, AI or machine learning.
Practical experience developing generative AI or LLM-based applications.
Strong proficiency in Python and understanding of machine learning and deep learning.
Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow or Scikit-learn.
Knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings and vector databases.
Experience with RAG architectures, AI service integrations and REST APIs.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and research skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or open-source LLMs.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex or similar frameworks.
Experience with AI agents, multi-agent systems, fine-tuning or local LLM deployment.
Experience with NLP, computer vision or document processing.
Familiarity with MLOps, Docker and cloud platforms.
Knowledge of AI security, data privacy and responsible AI practices.
Experience in enterprise AI applications or R&D projects.
Romanian language skills.
 📩 Interested in Joining Our Team?
 We encourage you to apply directly through LinkedIn.
 We look forward to meeting professionals who share our commitment to quality, professionalism and successful project delivery.
 Build your future with CCN. Be part of a project that makes a difference.
